entry.title: Find the right words
entry.use_when: A clear email, a kind reply, a better first draft.
entry.freshness: Review after use; verify current external facts before relying on them.
entry.limitations: A reusable prompt for an existing assistant; tool access and authority come from the actual task.

variants.label: Decline without ambiguity
variants.method: State the decline early, give only the explanation the user wants, and offer an alternative only if they can actually commit to it.
variants.output: A concise reply that leaves no uncertainty about attendance or acceptance.

variants.label: Explain a delay
variants.method: State what is delayed, what remains usable and the next reliable update. Distinguish a confirmed date from an estimate.
variants.output: A clear status message with an honest next update, without invented promises.

pattern.activation: a message needs a clear point, a suitable tone or an easier next step for its reader.

use_cases.title: Write a difficult reply
use_cases.outcome: One sendable draft with a clear next step and no invented commitments.

links.why: Writing shapes a message for its recipient; summarizing condenses existing material while preserving its evidence.
